final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country AS country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.cnt) AS total_records, AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total) AS avg_share, AVG(c.cnt - t.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c, t WHERE c.cnt > t.avg_cnt
